questions.question: What does associativity say about the expression $a\star b\star c$?
options: The order of $a,b,c$ may be changed freely.
Every element must have an inverse.
The operation must have an identity element.
The placement of parentheses does not change the result.
questions.explanation: Associativity is the identity $(a\star b)\star c=a\star(b\star c)$, so regrouping three inputs does not change the result.
questions.source_support: Definition: $(a\star b)\star c=a\star(b\star c)$ for all $a,b,c\in A$.
